verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-schedulable recurring jobs or workflows. Scheduled Rollouts are a one-off, time-based gradual release of a single gate, not a recurring schedule. The daily first-exposure rollups are Statsig's own internal processing, not a user-defined job. Running the CLI from CI/CD pipelines is a user-side workaround that relies on external schedulers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
